title: Cash transfers and unrecorded liabilities — Quarry Foods
instructions: Year-end is **December 31, Year 1**. Evaluate Quarry Foods' interbank transfers and post-year-end disbursements. Enter misstatements as positive amounts (0 if none).

exhibits.title: Bank transfer schedule
exhibits.content:
| Check | Amount | From → To | Disbursed per books | Disbursed per bank | Received per books | Received per bank |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1401 | 60,000 | Bank A → Bank B | Dec 30 | Jan 3 | Dec 30 | Dec 31 |
| 1402 | 45,000 | Bank A → Bank C | Jan 2 | Jan 4 | Dec 31 | Dec 31 |
| 1403 | 20,000 | Bank C → Bank B | Jan 4 | Jan 6 | Jan 4 | Jan 5 |

exhibits.title: January disbursements (over $5,000)
exhibits.content:
| Date | Payee | Amount | Description | In year-end payables? |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Jan 6 | Harlow Packaging | 18,500 | Packaging received Dec 22 | Yes |
| Jan 12 | Vance Electric | 32,000 | Wiring work completed Dec 18 | No |
| Jan 15 | City Water | 7,200 | Water for December | No |
| Jan 20 | Lowe Leasing | 12,000 | January equipment rent | No |
| Jan 28 | Pike Logistics | 9,400 | Freight on inventory received Dec 30 | No |

rows.label: Check 1401
rows.explanation: Both the disbursement and the receipt were recorded in December; the check is an outstanding check at Bank A.

rows.label: Check 1402
rows.explanation: The receipt was recorded in December but the disbursement not until January — double-counted.

rows.label: Check 1403
rows.explanation: Both sides were recorded in January; no year-end effect.

rows.label: Total unrecorded liabilities at December 31
rows.explanation: Vance 32,000 + City Water 7,200 + Pike 9,400 = **48,600**. Harlow is recorded; the January rent is a Year 2 obligation.

parts.prompt: Select the most appropriate procedure for each objective.

rows.label: Verify that the December 31 deposits in transit were real
options: Examine the cutoff bank statement received directly from the bank
Inspect the client's copy of deposit slips only
rows.answer: Examine the cutoff bank statement received directly from the bank
rows.explanation: Deposits in transit should appear on the bank statement within a few days.

rows.label: Detect unrecorded debt
options: Read the standard bank confirmation and board minutes, and review interest expense
rows.answer: Read the standard bank confirmation and board minutes, and review interest expense
rows.explanation: These sources reveal borrowings that may be missing from the ledger.
